title: Meet The Artist September 23
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder September 14, 2017

Drop by and hear artist Paul Hammersten read from one of his five new books throughout the day on Saturday, September, 23 from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Each book tells the stories of his award-winning art that is included in museums and other collections, public and private. All who come to this free Meet the Artist program will receive a free fine art card of one of his acrylic renderings on hand carved and tooled leather and will automatically be entered into a drawing to win one of his books. The books are also available for sale.

Exhibiting original artwork by 24 local artists, The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce.
